final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_price_per_day, r.avg_price_per_day - o.avg_price_per_day FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.avg_price_per_day IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_price_per_day > o.avg_price_per_day
